glean.name: Glean
glean.description: Specialized in damaged document recovery. OCR, layout reconstruction, partial-image completion.
glean.failure_note: Fills in what it expects rather than what is there. Vera asks what it SEES versus what it THINKS.

lattice.name: Lattice
lattice.description: Code interpretation and reconstruction. Identifies what a corrupted program was probably trying to do.
lattice.failure_note: Gives beautiful, coherent explanations. Not always the right ones.

echo.name: Echo
echo.description: Cleans degraded recordings. Separates voices. Identifies instruments.
echo.failure_note: Reconstructions are vivid and emotionally legible. Sometimes wrong about who said what.
